footer.nothing_changes: Nothing on the card is changed
footer.nothing_changed: Nothing on the card was changed

settings.title: Settings
settings.save_failed: Your choice could not be saved. It lasts until you close Revenant.

error.lead: Nothing was written to the card. The files you already recovered are still saved.

read_failed.title: Something went wrong while reading the card
read_failed.action: try again. If it keeps happening, make a copy of the card first and look for the files in the copy.

open_failed.title: The card could not be opened
open_failed.action: check that it is still connected and try again. If it keeps happening, take the card out, put it back and wait a few seconds.

permission_denied.title: Revenant did not get permission
permission_denied.action: try again and accept the permission request in the system window.

device_not_found.title: The disk was not found
device_not_found.action: check that it is still connected and choose it again.

system_tool_failed.title: The connected disks could not be listed
system_tool_failed.action: try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, close Revenant and open it again.

unsupported_platform.title: Revenant does not work on this computer
unsupported_platform.action: use Revenant on a Mac or on a Windows PC.

system_disk.title: This is the system disk
system_disk.action: choose the card or the external disk the photos and videos disappeared from. The system disk cannot be searched.

not_whole_disk.title: Choose the whole disk
not_whole_disk.action: go back and choose the card or the disk in the list, not just one part of it.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.action: try again. If it keeps happening, close Revenant and open it again.
